Gifted: Wings.name: Gifted: Wings
Gifted: Wings.description:
🧬 Wings, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you take off onto rooftops and across rivers, glide down from any height, and beat a gust that pushes people back and clears smoke.
📈 With training: people carried out, scenes read from above, diving strikes, steered feathers, a group sheltered, a street swept in one pass, a burning tower cleared.
⚠️ Rain, wind and low ceilings ground you.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as hard flying tears at the muscles of your back.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hawks (Fierce Wings).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Wings.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Wings family): Scale: wings about twice the user's height tip to tip, feathered unless the player chose leathery or insect. At first: a few blocks at a time at about a car's town speed, a rooftop in seconds, gliding down from any height; carrying an adult or long flight needs a learned technique. Limits: indoors, in alleys or under low ceilings, hops and glides only. Rain, wind and cold slow or ground them; a hurt, netted or grabbed wing downs them. Only feathered wings shed and steer feathers, by technique; a suppressing stare drops steered feathers, never the wings. Quirk Strain: wings themselves cost nothing; light: takeoff, gust; moderate: carry, overwatch, dive; heavy: steering feathers, sheltering people; severe: signature pass, clearing a burning tower. Type: Mutant. Law: wings break no law, but unlicensed public flight is unlawful Quirk use and diving on a person is assault.
